rubric.description: Quality of the overview of the project
rubric.long_description: The following contents should be clearly elucidated in the presentation: overview of the overall project goals, objectives, achievements, stakeholders and scope

ratings.long_description: The project presentation provides excellent and professional elaboration and in-depth clear explanations on all the key and relevant aspects and fully addresses and covers all the criteria including overview of the project including goals, objectives, achievements, stakeholders and scope (concise and clear).

The project presentation clearly explains and addresses all the criteria but with some ambiguity or more in-depth explanations are expected. Criteria including overview of the project including goals, objectives, achievements, stakeholders and scope (concise and clear).

The project presentation generally explains and meets a substantial majority of the criteria but missing out OR/AND not clearly addressing/shallow explanations on some of the criteria including overview of the project including goals, objectives, achievements, stakeholders and scope (concise and clear).

The project presentation gives brief or light explanations on most criteria but lacking/missing proper explanations OR/AND there are flaws in the explanation of the criteria, or includes contents generated by AI tools.
The project presentation lacks or misses clear and proper explanations on a major portion OR/AND there are flaws in the explanations of the criteria; or the majority of the contents generated by AI.

rubric.description: Quality of system specification and design
rubric.long_description:
The following contents should be clearly elucidated in the presentation and the user stories and requirements should be fully implemented by the high-quality designs:



● Summary of key functional and non-functional requirements expressed in the format of user stories



● Examples of representative user stories with the corresponding acceptance criteria

◦ Each user story should be the smallest unit of work for specific functional or non-functional requirement instead of a combination of several user stories

◦ Each user story should be clearly described and designed based on client's needs



◦ Each user story should be testable and estimable



● Technical and other constraints



● Final (complete) system architecture and design



◦ May include high-level designs (e.g., mock-ups, UIs, system/software components and its interactions

ratings.long_description:
The project presentation is excellent and of professional quality, fully covers and meets all the following criteria:
Summary of key functional and non-functional requirements expressed in the format of user stories

The project's presentation meets some of the criteria, AND/OR the clarity, more details and accuracy of the presentation are expected. Or some contents were generated by AI tools and lacks of students contributions.

rubric.long_description:
The following contents should be clearly elucidated in the presentation and the test-related work should be appropriate and sufficient with satisfactory results to ensure the project quality from multiple perspectives:



● Testing plans such as user acceptance testing, system testing, API testing and/or UI testing

◦ Use of relevant testing types (e.g., unit tests, regression testing, integration, system, usability and/or acceptance testing)

◦ A justification for why these tests are sufficient should also be included.

Any other quality aspects or testing-related work specific to the project nature (e.g., API testing, UI testing, stress testing)

● Demonstrate execution of designed test cases and corresponding results (e.g., bugs, bug fixes)

◦ Test cases should be consistent with user stories and cover different aspects of all user stories

◦ Explain why the current test cases are enough for the project

● Demonstrate enough test coverage and explain why it is enough for the scope of the project

● Summary of the significance and limitations of tests

rubric.description: Quality of Demo of the final design/product
rubric.long_description:
● It should cover all the implemented elements in the system/software/design or any work required to be completed by the client

● It should match the user stories/requirements described above

● The demo should be included in the submission along with the presentation slides.

● It will be assessed based on how well (quality) the most crucial user stories are implemented

ratings.long_description: The project demo is excellent and of professional quality, fully covers and addresses all the criteria. The exceptional quality of the demo is an excellent wrap up of the successful delivery of the project.
The project demo is of professional quality and fully covers all the criteria. The overall quality of the demo is sound.
The project demo is of good quality and covers most of the criteria.
The quality of the project demo needs to be properly improved and meets a few of the criteria but miss out a some portion of criteria. Some contents may be generated by AI.
Very limited quality, contents do not meet most of the criteria or primarily generated by AI.

rubric.description: Quality of Group Processes, Reflection, & Professional Practice
rubric.long_description:
The following contents should be clearly elucidated in the presentation :

● Summary of collaboration and teamwork

● Follow a systematic process of work - weekly plan and task allocation

● “Issues” tracking and progress;

● Use of Github and slack and other previously unfamiliar tools

● Work with clients - group interaction with client

● Summary of group member's contribution to the presentation/project (1 slide listing role/s of each member in the presentation/project)

● Critical assessment and Reflections, and professional practice

ratings.long_description: Contents in this section are clearly and professionally explained and excellently address all the criteria; highlights on group dynamics, task allocations and their contributions, issue tracking and problem solving, effective and efficient collaborations with client; Critical assessment and Reflections. Professionally address all the criteria with well-balanced contents and highlights.

Explains and meets substantial majority of the criteria; present group dynamics, task allocations and their contributions, issue tracking and problem solving, effective and efficient collaborations with client; Critical assessment and Reflections.
Brief on the contents that meet most of the criteria; may lacks highlights on group dynamics/client collaboration/critical assessment and Reflection or other criteria.
Contents in this section explain a few of the criteria but miss out some portion OR/AND there are flaws in the explanation of the criteria. Some contents generated by AI.
Contents in this section fail to explain and does not meet most of the criteria; contents are not relevant or primarily generated by AI.

rubric.long_description:
● Presentation is well-structured and has logical flow of information

● Presentation is well-prepared and well-rehearsed

● The delivery is within the time limit

● Fully and appropriate utilization of presentation tools (slides, animation, visuals, etc.)

● The slides are easy-to-read, clear and concise with appropriate titles and styles and without too much text

ratings.long_description: Exceptional and influential presentation demonstrating professional standard and remarkably high-quality. Presentation criteria fully and professionally addressed and contents attract and hold audience's attention throughout the entire presentation. All members are enthusiastic and well-prepared and actively contribute to the presentation.

Impressive presentation demonstrating professional standard. Presentation criteria are properly addressed and contents attract and hold audience's attention.  All members are well-prepared, but one group member actively contribute to the presentation.
Presentation criteria are basically addressed and most of members are well-prepared for the presentation, but two members do not actively contribute to the presentation.

Not all criteria are addressed and some (3-4) members are well-prepared for the presentation, but the rest of the members are not demonstrating strong presentation skills and some of members don not actively contribute to the presentation.
Fails to meet / address the criteria.

rubric.description: Quality of Q&As and Group Contribution
rubric.long_description: convincing and sensible answers that show understanding of the work done; all members have sensible contributions to the presentation and demo; all members are actively participating in the presentation/demo and q&amp;amp;amp;a.

ratings.long_description: Excellent collaborative efforts and advanced skills in inspiring and engaging audience for discussion and providing convincing and sensible answers. All members are active and contributing to answering all the questions from the audience.
The group collaboratively and properly answers questions from the audience; nearly all members actively provide convincing and sensible answers to show their understanding of the work and techniques.
Some (3-4) of the members play key role in Q&A while rest of members does not actively participate or engage in answering the questions. Answers are not always convincing or sensible.
Only one or two members contribute to Q&A while rest of members does not participate or engage in answering the questions. The presentation does not inspire questions from audience.
The presentation does not inspire questions from audience or the questions are not properly answered.
